Summary: Baptism is the public sign Jesus gave His church marking a believer's union with Him in His death and resurrection and their entry into His people. Going under the water pictures being washed clean; rising pictures new life in Christ. Baptism does not save by itself, but it joyfully obeys the Savior who saves.
KeyPassages: Matthew 3:13-17; Matthew 28:19; Acts 2:38-41; Acts 8:36-38; Romans 6:3-4; Colossians 2:12; 1 Peter 3:21
RelatedPeople: Jesus; John the Baptist; Peter; Philip; Paul
RelatedQuestions: Why do Christians get baptized?; Should babies be baptized?
